decision: PM-approved implementation choice under the user's autonomous product-development authorization; not a claim of user gameplay acceptance or calibrated balance
safeOrdersSource: V2_CONFIG.intro.safeOrders (currently 15), evaluated once at batch acceptance from heroCompletedOrders
distanceQuantization: Require finite nonnegative raw heldMetres and safe-integer result, then max(1, Math.round(raw)); allow an otherwise-legal zero-length route instead of newly rejecting it
weight: Positive safe-integer actual order weightKg for new priced contracts, never vehicle capacity
incomeCents: Math.round(map ordinaryBaseFee * 100 * locked vehicle incomeFactor * locked xpMultiplier * F), rounded once only
preserve: Existing intro batch-level protection and purchase/upgrade/recruit prices
Existing signed contract amounts and all receipts
Current unique slot, configId and strict restore/atomic writer protections
compatibility: Optional versioned ordinaryPricing metadata on new ordinary quotes; absent metadata keeps original quote validation with no synthesized distance or repricing; unknown version rejects without clearing saves
releaseGate: Production inputs come only from validated GameSession routes; preview/accept/settlement share the frozen contract; validate new and old representations before coordinated deployment
limits: The 0.90-to-1.20 range is a bounded product choice, not a measured order-supply average
No guarantee that every distinct order has a distinct rounded price
No claim of a measured 20-minute team or 98-percent UI completion
No new parameters are deployed by writing this rule file alone
